scripts.test:unit: npm run cir:generate && tsc --noEmit && bun test ./tests/unit/
scripts.build: tsc --noEmit && npm run build:runtime && bun build src/rwrc/index.ts --compile --outfile dist/rwrc
scripts.test:backend: npm run cir:generate && npm run build && cp ./docs/schema/cir.schema.json ./dist && bun test ./tests/backend/*.test.ts
scripts.build:runtime: mkdir -p dist && rm -rf dist/include && bun run cp -R src/runtime/include dist/include && clang -I dist/include src/runtime/*.c -dynamiclib -fvisibility=hidden -current_version 0.0.1 -compatibility_version 0.0.1 -o dist/libClawr.A.dylib
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:backend && npm run test:e2e
